name: Sanjana R.
quote: I joined with zero coding background. My mentor never made me feel behind — we just kept building until things clicked. Six months later I had an offer letter in hand.

name: Mohammed Faizal
quote: What stood out was how patient the mentors were with doubts. No question felt small. The projects on my resume are the exact reason I got shortlisted.

name: Keerthana V.
quote: The portfolio reviews genuinely changed how I think about design. Interviewers kept asking about my case studies — that's when I knew the program actually worked.

name: Arjun Balaji
quote: Hands-on labs from day one. I broke things, fixed them, and actually understood why. That confidence carried straight into my interviews.

name: Nithya Suresh
quote: I was intimidated by AI before this. The mentors broke it down step by step until I was building my own RAG chatbot. Placement support followed up with me every single week.

name: Vikram Anand
quote: Shipping my first real app to the Play Store felt unreal. The mentors treated us like future colleagues, not just students.
